XS.$description: Outer tap target for button size XS. The pressed face moves inside this box, so the box never changes height.

S.$description: Outer tap target for button size S. The pressed face moves inside this box, so the box never changes height.

M.$description: Outer tap target for button size M. The pressed face moves inside this box, so the box never changes height.

L.$description: Outer tap target for button size L. The pressed face moves inside this box, so the box never changes height.

XS.$description: Height of the solid edge under the button face at size XS. Present at rest, gone when pressed.

S.$description: Height of the solid edge under the button face at size S. Present at rest, gone when pressed.

M.$description: Height of the solid edge under the button face at size M. Present at rest, gone when pressed.

L.$description: Height of the solid edge under the button face at size L. Present at rest, gone when pressed.

XS.$description: Face height while pressed at size XS. Face height minus lip, so the face sinks flush without the outer box growing.

L.$description: Face height while pressed at size L. Face height minus lip, so the face sinks flush without the outer box growing.

Primary.$description: Fill of the lip under a Primary button face. The same perceptual step as the Secondary lip, on a much lighter face.

Secondary.$description: Fill of the lip under a Secondary button face. The same perceptual step as the Primary lip, on a much darker face.

pressScale.$description: Scale a Tertiary button's label takes while pressed, from its own centre. Tertiary has no fill and no lip, so the label is the only thing that can move.

page.$description: Root canvas behind every screen, with cards and sheets on background.surface instead.

surface.$description: Elevated container fill for cards, bottom sheets, modals, menus, chat bubbles and toasts.

inverse.$description: Light block on the dark page for tooltips, toasts and snackbars, paired with text.inverse.

scrim.$description: Semi-transparent overlay that dims content behind a modal, dialog or bottom sheet.

floating.$description: Translucent frosted-glass fill for menus, tooltips and popovers that float above content.

stacking.$description: Additive white layer that lifts toasts and floating notifications off dark surfaces.

input.$description: Resting fill of editable fields such as text inputs, textareas and search.

primary.$description: Fill for the one main call to action per screen and for progress bar fills.

primaryActive.$description: Pressed state of interactive.primary at the moment of tap or click.

onPrimary.$description: Text and icons on interactive.primary, holding at least 4.5:1 against it.

secondary.$description: Fill for supporting actions such as Skip, Cancel, filter chips, outlined buttons and toggles.

onSecondary.$description: Text and icons on interactive.secondary fills.

destructive.$description: Fill for irreversible harmful actions such as delete, remove and block.

onDestructive.$description: Text and icons on interactive.destructive, holding at least 4.5:1 against it.

disabled.$description: Fill for controls that are unavailable, paired with text.disabled.

pressed.$description: Press overlay layered on the resting fill of elements on light or vivid surfaces.

pressedInverse.$description: Press overlay layered on the resting fill of elements on dark surfaces.

primary.$description: Default highest-contrast text for headlines, body copy, titles and labels.

secondary.$description: Reduced-emphasis text for subtitles, captions, timestamps, helper text and metadata.

tertiary.$description: Lowest-emphasis readable text for counts and inline hints, never for anything needed to proceed.

disabled.$description: Text on disabled controls and placeholder text in empty fields.

inverse.$description: Dark text on light or vivid fills such as background.inverse.

link.$description: Inline hyperlink text in body copy only, not buttons or navigation.

success.$description: Confirmation text such as Correct or a passed validation message.

error.$description: Validation message text under a failed field.

warning.$description: Caution text for limits, expiry notices and last-attempt messages.

onAccent.$description: Text on any accent bold fill, holding at least 4.5:1 against it.

default.$description: Standard edge for card outlines, dividers, separators and inputs at rest.

strong.$description: Higher-contrast edge for dividers and table rules that must read at a glance.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring for any focusable element, drawn at Stroke.Heavy Border.

focusSecondary.$description: Keyboard focus ring for secondary buttons, chips and toggles where the violet ring reads weakly.

focusDestructive.$description: White keyboard focus ring for delete and remove buttons.

error.$description: Edge of an input that failed validation, paired with text.error.

success.$description: Edge of an input confirmed correct.

selected.$description: Edge of a chosen card, active tab or picked answer, paired with highlight.surface.

surface.$description: Fill of a chosen card, active tab or picked answer.

border.$description: Edge of a chosen element sitting on highlight.surface, never used alone.

primary.$description: Knowie's signature violet for mascot fills and mascot-hero screens, only when Knowie is present.

eyes.$description: Knowie's eye whites, for mascot illustration only.

pupils.$description: Knowie's pupils, for mascot illustration only.

bold.$description: Solid green accent fill for streak counters, progress markers and positive stat chips.

subtle.$description: Low-emphasis green tint behind a green stat, chip or panel.

bold.$description: Solid coral accent fill for decorative emphasis, category tags and illustration accents.

subtle.$description: Low-emphasis coral tint behind a coral stat, chip or panel.

bold.$description: Solid blue accent fill for informational chips and secondary category tags.

subtle.$description: Low-emphasis blue tint behind a blue stat, chip or panel.

bold.$description: Solid magenta accent fill for decorative category tags.

subtle.$description: Low-emphasis magenta tint behind a magenta stat, chip or panel.

bold.$description: Solid brand accent fill for brand moments and onboarding hero panels.

subtle.$description: Low-emphasis brand tint behind a brand stat, chip or panel.

bold.$description: Solid PRO fill for PRO badges and upgrade banners.

subtle.$description: Low-emphasis PRO tint behind PRO content.

accent.$description: Legacy alias of pro.bold for PRO badges and upgrade prompts.

bold.$description: Solid success fill for correct answer banners and completion states.

subtle.$description: Tinted success panel behind a correct result.

bold.$description: Solid error fill for incorrect answer banners and failed validation summaries.

subtle.$description: Tinted error panel behind a wrong result.

bold.$description: Solid warning fill for caution states that are not a verdict.

subtle.$description: Tinted warning panel behind a caution message.

bold.$description: Solid partial fill for the almost verdict banner in the recall loop.

subtle.$description: Tinted partial panel behind a partial result.

pressIn.$description: How long a button takes to sink under the finger. Faster than it comes back, so the press feels immediate.

pressOut.$description: How long a button takes to rise after release. Twice the press, so the release feels like a spring rather than a snap.

press.$description: Easing for a button press, in and out.
